scope: RoboTwin and MuJoCo first-pass physics for every Xbox One S control represented by the licensed visual asset

small_buttons.applicability: Numerical proxy only; no Xbox small-button force measurement is available.

shoulders.travel: artist cap travel; the reference switch travel is not substituted for lever travel

triggers.applicability: Cross-control torque scale used only as a simulation placeholder; it is not an Xbox trigger measurement.

sticks.tilt_dynamics: reuse sources/robotwin_left_stick_estimated_v0.json for both identical reference modules

dpad.lever_arm_basis: rounded half-width of the metric-scaled D-pad visual
dpad.applicability: First-pass rocker estimate; Xbox membrane force and cap lever ratio are unmeasured.

collision_policy.buttons: cylinder fitted inside converted visual AABB
collision_policy.sticks: reuse axisymmetric three-cylinder proxy from the left-stick vertical slice
collision_policy.dpad: two crossed boxes fitted inside converted visual AABB
collision_policy.bumpers_and_triggers: box fitted to 90 percent of converted visual AABB
collision_policy.shell: central support plus explicit stick gate rings; visual triangle mesh is not used as a dynamic collision mesh

mass_policy.method: primitive collision volume * density * group fill factor; body receives remaining whole mass

passive_preload_policy.applies_to: buttons, shoulders, triggers, stick clicks and Pair
passive_preload_policy.does_not_apply_to: bidirectional stick tilt and D-pad rocker joints
passive_preload_policy.derivation: The no-preload MuJoCo trigger settled at 1.216% of travel under gravity; 1.5% adds a 0.284 percentage-point stop preload margin.
passive_preload_policy.status: simulation estimate derived from the no-preload run; replace with measured preload

signal_policy.button_output: continuous [0,1] travel fraction; consuming task chooses a digital threshold

known_unknowns: Trigger torsion spring and compliant end-stop curves
D-pad membrane force and exact diagonal envelope
Cap-to-shell clearances and hidden guide geometry
Pair button has no canonical game action channel
replacement_plan: Replace estimated values with owner measurements listed in docs/pending_user_review.md without changing joint or channel names.
